description: Engine §4.1 and §6: a guarded higher option fails at an erased interior, so ranked admission keeps the named error.
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution fewest #·zz
%rule text $e:e ($g:A ≻ bad) :: ∅
%conditions $g ⟹ $e ≅ #(·e ∩ ⁅ a ⁆)
%rule e a
%erased
%rule a A
%rule bad A
%error "bad"
%rule zz B B B
